bot.name: Argo / Buddy dispatch
bot.mission: Rank open loops, overdue work, callbacks, escalations, and QA-ready closures before Edwin spends energy.

bot_dispatch.name: Argo / Buddy dispatch
bot_dispatch.guardrail: Bot token must live in a secret store, never in Notion or transcripts.
bot_dispatch.external_effects: Notion updates, Slack app messages, Gmail sends, Calendar mutations, GitHub publish, and iCloud export require confirmation gates.

capture: resolution pattern that applies to future cases
learning_loop.promotion_rule: promote a note only when it changes routing, priority, or the next useful action.

confirmation_gates.next_confirmation: repo owner/name or confirmation to create a new repo; branch name
local mounted folder path or authenticated upload route; confirmation that Maverick artifacts should be copied there
live row query method; write/update method
Slack channel or DM target where Maverick should communicate with Edwin; bot token stored only in a secret store

slack_app.secret_policy: Bot token must live in a secret store, never in Notion, dashboard JSON, docs, or transcripts.

delivery_rules: No draft may leave local disk until its live target is confirmed.
Every external action needs an exact MAVERICK-CONFIRM token for its gate and action id.
Slack signal watch remains read-only; Slack app messages use the separate slack_write gate.
Do not include secrets, bot tokens, direct personal contact details, or unverified case facts.

learning_events.lesson: Maverick must prioritize reduction lanes before expanding new work.
learning_events.next_action: Keep Daily Command focused on overdue, callback, false-close, and reactivation objectives.

learning_events.lesson: Overdue work is the clearest signal that the 14-day rule is under pressure.
learning_events.next_action: Promote overdue follow-ups into the first daily work block.

learning_events.lesson: Callbacks should be batched through the Callback canvas instead of handled one by one.
learning_events.next_action: Use the Callback canvas as the default route for call-stack actions.

learning_events.lesson: Resolved labels are not enough; QA must confirm the task is actually closed.
learning_events.next_action: Route resolved-but-open work through QA Breakdown before archive.

learning_events.lesson: Reactivation candidates should enter active review deliberately, not by copying stale rows wholesale.
learning_events.next_action: Use Portfolio Reconciliation as a candidate list, then verify each case before action.

learning_events.lesson: Slack signal watching and Slack app messaging are different lanes with different gates.
learning_events.next_action: Keep the watch read-only and use Comms Outbox plus slack_write for future app messages.

learning_events.lesson: Maverick should surface missing evidence instead of guessing live access.
learning_events.next_action: Use Activation Matrix before attempting publish, send, schedule, or update actions.

device_access.name: maverick-device-access
device_access.hard_rule: Maverick must work from every Edwin device through a stable device-safe URL; localhost is never the user-facing answer.

primary_access.reason: iPhone, iPad, Mac, and remote devices cannot depend on a Mac-only localhost session.
acceptable_hosts: GitHub Pages or equivalent HTTPS static host

limits: Mac must be awake and on the same network.
iPhone must be on the same Wi-Fi or reachable VPN.
This is not the always-on production answer.

installable_app.notes: Service workers require HTTPS or localhost. They activate after Maverick is on the public HTTPS host.

blocked_patterns: Do not give 127.0.0.1 as the final user device URL.
Do not depend on a single Codex browser tab for user-facing access.
Do not call a LAN URL always-on unless the Mac is managed to stay awake.
acceptance_checks: Dashboard renders on mobile width without horizontal layout failure.
A stable HTTPS URL is recorded once the public host is confirmed.
PWA manifest and service worker are shipped with the cockpit package.
LAN fallback command is available for same-Wi-Fi testing.

launchGates.label: Gmail

launchGates.label: Slack
launchGates.detail: User provided the Maverick Slack app id. The legacy Slack watch remains read-only; outbound communication through this app is disabled until target, secret handling, and per-message confirmation are settled.

launchGates.detail: No calendar source ownership is confirmed. Event mutation is disabled.
